concept.title: Support after a bereavement
concept.shortdesc: As someone who has lost a person close to me, I need bereavement support, so that I can cope with the loss.

conbody.note: Draft need (N-033). The needs catalogue is a model's draft from persona use cases and has not been agreed with stakeholders; the category links are proposals and are not confirmed.

section.title: The need
section.p: Situation: Grief support exists in many forms (groups, counselling, practical help).
A good result: Bereavement groups and counselling, including for children, with how to self-refer.
How much it matters: Important: a miss leaves someone without help they need.
